capabilities: Transform pasted HTML before converting it to Markdown
Apply custom regex replacements to pasted HTML and Markdown
Cascade pasted heading levels to match the document or cursor context
Strip empty elements, blank lines, and hard line breaks from pasted content
Paste text with all Markdown syntax escaped
extras: The README warns about conflicts with other plugins that override the default paste behavior and explains how to work around them by using a hotkey-bound command instead.
problem: Obsidian's default paste converts HTML to Markdown with no control over cleanup, heading depth, or custom text transformations.
summary: Paste-time reformatter that cleans pasted HTML, applies regex transformations, and adjusts heading levels before inserting content into notes.
